title: Regression Suite
doc: Reads a list of rows by id at startup and checks their columns against
values written down in advance, reporting PASS/FAIL per column. It
re-checks retuning arithmetic without a CKF Data Dump sweep, because a
sweep and row cloning cannot be used together: the mission hung on load
THE EXPECTATIONS FILE IS NOT A SCHEMA INPUT. Columns are
Table,Id,Column,Expect,Note, one row per assertion; it is bulk table
authoring, edited in a spreadsheet. Leave Expect blank to report a value
IT IS ONLY AS GOOD AS ITS BASELINE, which is why it is the one slice
that is off by default. Turn it on for a verification launch after a
retune, regenerate the expectations, read the block, turn it back off.
An expectations file older than the overlays it checks reports failures
that are only the file being out of date.
uiDoc: A startup check. It reads a list of rows by id and compares their columns against values written down in advance, reporting pass or fail for each one. It is how you confirm a retune landed without running a full data sweep.
To use it, turn it on for one launch after a retune, read the block it prints, then turn it back off.

The expectations are a plain table - table, id, column, expected value, note - one row per check, edited in a spreadsheet. Leave the expected value blank and it reports what it found without judging it, which is a quick way to read a column you are unsure about.
It is only as good as the values you wrote down. An expectations file that has not been refreshed since your last retune reports failures that are only the file being out of date.

fields.label: Enable Regression Suite
fields.doc: Slice toggle. It lives in ckf.hardmode.cfg because a gate cannot live inside the file it gates, and the .cfg is parsed before anything else loads. Slices.Init binds every [Slices] key above the [General] Enabled bail-out, so BepInEx writes the line even when the mod is off. A key that cannot be read is reported at Error and treated as on. Off: the subsystem logs why and does nothing this launch. The retired "enabled" key inside the subsystem's JSON file is still parsed (RetiredEnabled) so that Slices.ReportRetiredGate can report it: a Warning, or an Error when it is false and this key is not. Nothing branches on it. Default false: the only slice that is off by default.
fields.uiDoc: Turn this off and this part of the mod does nothing; the game uses its own values. The master switch on the first page turns off everything at once.

fields.absent: Blank means ckf.hardmode.selfcheck.csv in the config directory.
fields.label: Expectations file
fields.doc: The expectations file. Blank means ckf.hardmode.selfcheck.csv in the config directory. Columns: Table,Id,Column,Expect,Note. Leave Expect blank to report the value without judging it.

fields.label: Result table path
fields.doc: Where to write the result table. Blank means BepInEx/ckf-hardmode/selfcheck.csv. The log carries the same lines.
